name: @cupper/e2e
description: The e2e suite: Playwright drives the e2e build of the app, its real host, the fake agent and the CLI (design 5.9.4).

scripts.test:e2e: cargo xtask lock -- sh -c '[ "$1" = -- ] && shift; playwright test --grep-invert @focus --pass-with-no-tests "$@"; rest=$?; playwright test --grep @focus --workers 1 --pass-with-no-tests "$@" && exit $rest' e2e
